$comment: Traceability matrix: every bullet of the pdfnative CHANGELOG entry named by `engine` is either exercised THROUGH the CLI (named tests, and baseline samples where a sample can show it) or waived with a reason. tests/regression/engine-surface.test.ts holds every reference to the tree. Extend it in the same change that moves the pdfnative pin (CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Bumping the engine pin'). Waiver kinds: LIB (a JavaScript API with no command-line meaning), TOOLING (the engine repository's own tooling), DOCS (engine documentation), tested-upstream (an engine rule the CLI only transmits; `transmission` names the suite that proves the transmission), upstream-limit (a known limit pinned by an it.fails marker and listed in ROADMAP.md).
